role: A semantic layer inside the database: business entities, dimensions, facts and governed metrics defined once in Exasol, then queried by SQL users, BI tools and AI agents through one compiler. Everything it installs lives in the database: Lua scripts and catalog tables in SYS_SEMANTIC, SEMANTIC_CATALOG, SEMANTIC_ADMIN, SEMANTIC_AGENT and SEMANTIC_SOURCE, and the role SEMANTIC_USER.
installed_by: Never by the installer. Only through exakit marketplace.
platforms: Wherever the kit's database runs: it installs into the database, not onto this computer.

quickstart.note: The kit downloads the release it pins, checks its SHA-256, and runs the release's own installer against the local database as the kit's administrator. Running it again is safe: models already defined are kept.

quickstart.run: exakit sql 'SELECT DISPLAY_VERSION, INSTALLED_AT FROM SEMANTIC_CATALOG.PRODUCT_VERSION'

quickstart.note: Semantic SQL is switched on per session. Create a model and its metrics first: the exasol-semantic-modeler skill and the project's docs/creating-metrics.md walk through it.

parameters.name: <addon-id>...
parameters.description: Install only these registered add-ons. Without IDs, open the chooser on a terminal; install nothing without a terminal.

parameters.name: --list
parameters.description: List add-ons and ownership without installing. Cannot be combined with install IDs.

parameters.name: --json
parameters.description: List add-ons as JSON; read-only and cannot be combined with install IDs.

parameters.name: --help, -h
parameters.description: Show this command reference without installing or restarting anything.

commands.summary: Install the release versions.json pins now; the database keeps its models.

parameters.name: <component>
parameters.description: Update a kit-owned component or add-on; user-owned components are preserved. For this add-on, use semantic-views.

parameters.name: --yes, -y
parameters.description: Allow a pending runtime update that stops and restarts the database; not permission to remove user-owned resources.
parameters.default: ask on a terminal; defer runtime changes without a terminal

parameters.name: --json, -j
parameters.description: Print machine-readable output rather than decorated text.

parameters.name: --help, -h
parameters.description: Show this command reference without installing or restarting anything.

commands.summary: Remove its schemas and role, only when no model is defined.

parameters.name: <addon-id>
parameters.description: Remove one kit-owned add-on. Without an ID, choose components interactively; --yes without an ID selects the whole kit. User-owned resources are preserved.

parameters.name: --yes, -y
parameters.description: Confirm removal. With no addon ID, remove the full kit and kit-owned database data.

parameters.name: --help, -h
parameters.description: Show this command reference without installing or restarting anything.

notes: The admin APIs are Lua scripts: call them with EXECUTE SCRIPT SEMANTIC_ADMIN.<name>(...), never as SELECT SEMANTIC_ADMIN.<name>(...).
Your AI clients can read the semantic catalog through the kit's MCP server; the exasol-semantic-analyst, -modeler and -reviewer skills arrive with the add-on.
Uninstall never deletes a model: with one defined it stops and says so. Drop them first with EXECUTE SCRIPT SEMANTIC_ADMIN.DROP_MODEL(...).

troubleshooting.symptom: Semantic Views is already in the database and was not installed by the kit
troubleshooting.fix: It was installed with its own tools/install.py. The kit leaves it to that owner: update it the same way, or remove it there.
The downloaded archive is not the release the kit pins. Nothing was installed. Try again; if it persists, report it.
